vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
Version: 1.103.2

This skill bundle automates posting to Weibo by controlling a Chrome browser via CDP and simulating system-level clipboard and keystroke events. It utilizes high-risk methods such as executing AppleScript (osascript), PowerShell, and Swift code to manipulate the system clipboard and send "Paste" commands (found in scripts/copy-to-clipboard.ts and scripts/paste-from-clipboard.ts). While these capabilities are plausibly necessary to bypass anti-bot detection and handle rich text/images as described in SKILL.md, the use of system-level automation and shell command construction represents a significant security risk. No evidence of intentional malice, such as data exfiltration or backdoors, was found.

llm.summary: The skill’s Weibo posting purpose is clear, but it uses a persistent logged-in Chrome profile and explicitly advertises anti-bot bypassing, so it needs careful review before use.

dimensions.detail: The Weibo posting capability is coherent with the description, but the skill explicitly says it uses a real Chrome browser to bypass anti-bot detection for a public social-media platform.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions say the scripts compose content and the user must manually review and publish, which limits account-impacting automation; however, the agent is also given browser-control and troubleshooting instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, but the skill runs TypeScript through bun or npx and depends on npm packages. This is purpose-aligned but users should trust the runtime and dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses Chrome CDP, OS clipboard helpers, and real paste keystrokes. These are relevant to rich-content posting but are broad local-environment controls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on a persistent logged-in Weibo browser session and supports configurable Chrome profiles, which can affect which account/session is used.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a skill controlling Chrome and the system clipboard to compose Weibo content. Use a separate Chrome profile and Weibo account, inspect any EXTEND.md configuration, verify the browser is logged into the intended account, and manually review everything before clicking publish.
llm.findings:
[suspicious.dangerous_exec] expected: scripts/copy-to-clipboard.ts uses child_process spawn to call platform clipboard tools. This is expected for copying images/HTML to the system clipboard, but it is still local command execution.
[suspicious.dangerous_exec] expected: scripts/paste-from-clipboard.ts uses osascript/xdotool/ydotool/PowerShell to send a real paste keystroke. This supports the stated browser workflow, but it can affect the active application if focus is wrong.
[suspicious.dangerous_exec] expected: scripts/weibo-utils.ts runs a shell command to determine the Windows user profile path. That appears related to locating a Chrome profile, but full context for the utility file was not included in the visible artifact text.

evidence.explanation: The skill is not merely automating a browser; it explicitly frames the real-browser workflow as bypassing anti-bot detection on a social platform.
evidence.snippet: Posts text, images, videos, and long-form articles to Weibo via real Chrome browser (bypasses anti-bot detection).

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use only with a dedicated Weibo account/profile that you control, and keep manual review before publishing. Avoid using it for bulk, spam, or policy-evading posting.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Using this skill could put the user’s Weibo account at risk of platform enforcement or unintended automated behavior, even though final publishing is described as manual.

evidence.explanation: The skill depends on a persistent logged-in browser session, which is credential-like authority over the user’s Weibo account.
evidence.snippet: First run: log in to Weibo manually (session saved)

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use a dedicated Chrome profile for this skill, confirm the logged-in Weibo account before composing, and log out or delete the profile if you no longer need the skill.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The skill can act in a browser session that is already logged in to Weibo, so the chosen Chrome profile determines which account is affected.

evidence.explanation: A project-local persistent configuration file can override the default Chrome profile used by the skill, and that profile controls the logged-in account/session.
evidence.snippet: Check EXTEND.md in priority order — the first one found wins: ... `.baoyu-skills/baoyu-post-to-weibo/EXTEND.md` | Project ... EXTEND.md supports: Default Chrome profile

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Inspect any EXTEND.md before use, prefer an explicit `--profile` pointing to a dedicated profile, and do not let untrusted projects define the Chrome profile.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A workspace or project configuration could steer the skill toward a different browser profile, potentially causing posts to be composed under an unintended Weibo account.

evidence.explanation: The script invokes OS automation to send paste keystrokes, which is consistent with the rich-text paste workflow but gives the skill local UI-control capability.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Watch the browser while the skill runs and avoid using the computer for other sensitive input during automated paste steps.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the wrong application has focus, clipboard content could be pasted somewhere unintended.

evidence.explanation: The runnable scripts depend on external npm packages with semver ranges, although a bun.lock file with package hashes is present.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the included lockfile where possible and install/run from a trusted checkout rather than allowing unreviewed dependency updates.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Running the skill may rely on third-party package code beyond the visible scripts.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses browser and OS automation for a public posting workflow and explicitly advertises anti-bot bypassing; no exfiltration or destructive behavior was shown.

permission_boundary.summary: The skill relies on a persistent logged-in Weibo browser session, so the selected Chrome profile controls account authority.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Project/user EXTEND.md configuration can influence the Chrome profile used, which could affect session/account selection.
